answer: The binding budget is the wall a sybil swarm cannot climb: every agent identity must escrow a stake that grows with its attested history, slashed to zero once a cluster correlates. A thousand puppets are cheap to spin up, but each must post collateral before voting or grading, so forging identities costs linearly, not free. A fake farm reaches its summit and stalls: staking every alias exceeds any harvest. When a gale of fresh addresses lands, shared funding and tight timing freeze the crop. Reputation in the shared garden of attestations cannot be transplanted.
